items.title: How much real signal actually gets through?
items.description: This is a simplified teaching model, not a real measurement of a relationship. L2's model has two levers: how narrow the question is, and how safe the person feels being candid with you. Drag the question toward Request 2 and 3 territory and notice that low safety still caps how many useful comments come through.
items.compute: const maxUsefulComments = Math.round(3 * (params.specificity / 100) * 10) / 10; const multiplier = 0.2 + 0.8 * (params.safety / 100); const usefulComments = Math.round(maxUsefulComments * multiplier * 10) / 10; const commentsLostToLowSafety = Math.max(0, Math.round((maxUsefulComments - usefulComments) * 10) / 10); return { usefulComments, commentsLostToLowSafety };

outputs.label: Useful comments lost to low safety
